name: Flat Lay
short_description: Keep the exact product from the input image completely unchanged - preserve its colors, shape, texture, and all visual characteristics. Only change the camera angle to top-down view, background to neutral clean surface, and lighting to bright overhead lighting. The product itself must remain identical to the input.
product_preservation_instruction: CRITICAL: The product must remain visually identical to the input image. Do not alter, reinterpret, or regenerate the product. Only modify the environment (background, lighting, camera angle) around the unchanged product.
